artikel.titel: How Polish households are saving and investing in 2026
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Why Poland’s new Personal Investment Account could prove popular with Polish investors

artikel.titel: Dutch minority government hangs in the balance over divisive tax plan
artikel.text: EUROPE: The Dutch government hangs in the balance after the 2027 tax plan was approved. The main economic risk is political paralysis delaying policy decisions needed to address bottlenecks and boost potential growth

artikel.titel: Eurozone industrial production ticked up but still unimpressive in September
artikel.text: The increase of 0.2% compared to August still leaves production well below levels seen in 2025. Despite optimistic manufacturing surveys, industrial production is not showing signs of a rebound

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Time for a break below 1.10 in EUR/USD?
artikel.text: EUR/USD is ready to test the key 1.100 support. We think the pair can hold the line in a light week for US data, but risks of a break lower are meaningful given the macro nature of this USD rally. Any AI-related equity market instability probably has a greater chance of denting this USD momentum than Fedspeak this week

artikel.titel: China’s October domestic activity data disappoints across the board
artikel.text: ASIA/PACIFIC: China’s retail sales, fixed-asset investment, and industrial production all came in weaker than expected in October, a worrying start to the fourth quarter. Signs of further stabilisation in property prices offer some rays of hope, but the domestic economy would benefit from more policy support

artikel.titel: Asia Outlook 2027: Growth broadens, capital gets selective
artikel.text: ASIA/PACIFIC: After a stronger-than-expected 2026, Asian growth should broaden in 2027 as AI tailwinds moderate, lower energy prices support demand and supply-chain diversification continues. Capital flows will become more selective as global financial conditions tighten. We favor the KRW, TWD, SGD, and expect Australia and Philippines to lead easing moves

artikel.titel: Poland’s current account deficit narrows on early EU farm payments
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Poland’s September current account deficit narrowed to €0.8bn, helped by early EU farm subsidies. Services remained strong, but net exports likely weighed on 3Q26 GDP growth. We forecast the deficit at 1.5% of GDP in 2026 and 1.9% in 2027

artikel.titel: THINK Ahead: How to survive without AI
artikel.text: We've all had to learn to live without a *certain* chatbot for the last 24 hours, but could the global economy survive without AI in 2027? James Smith goes all agentic and looks at how the economic effects of AI could change over the coming months

artikel.titel: CNB Minutes: Neither hikes nor cuts in the pipeline
artikel.text: CZECH REPUBLIC: The Bank Board increased interest rates to 4% in a close call, and we see valid arguments for both positions. Second-round effects will push inflation above the upper bound of the target corridor for some time, while dwindling economic activity warrants lots of caution. We see neither hikes nor cuts as the most likely outcome for quite some time

artikel.titel: CEE & CCA week ahead: A rate decision in Hungary and regional price data
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Hungary will announce its latest interest rate decision and release September wage data next week. Meanwhile, October's core inflation data is due from Poland, alongside producer price figures from the Czech Republic

trendfolge.regel: Absolute Momentum, 3 Monate (63 Handelstage), täglich entschieden (Antonacci 2014: 12 Monate, monatlich)
trendfolge.hinweis: Täglich entschieden und 3 statt 12 Monate Rückschau sind eigene Wahl, das Paper entscheidet monatlich über 12 Monate. Beides bringt mehr Fehlsignale, wenn der Markt schnell dreht. Keine Anlageberatung.
